collate_tokens: create a padded 2D tensor from a list of 1D token tensors with configurable padding and EOS handling
load_indexed_dataset: load a fairseq indexed dataset from a file path with optional dictionary and combined dataset support
compute_mask_indices: compute random mask spans for BERT-style masked language modeling with configurable mask probability and length
batch_by_size: yield mini-batches of dataset indices bucketed by token count with max tokens and sentences constraints
post_process: post process tokenized text by removing subword markers for sentencepiece wordpiece or subword_nmt formats
